# Requirements Quality Checklist: Soldiers at War Map Visualizer

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of specifications for the Soldiers at War Map Visualizer before task decomposition and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Reverse-Engineering & Binary Data Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the handling of gzip compression versus uncompressed raw map streams explicitly specified with dynamic header inspection? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Research §2]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are version header validation criteria defined for both v20 and v21 `AMB_MAP` stream variants? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Research §2]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the bitmask extraction formulas for cell component words (presence, tileset index, sprite index) explicitly documented with exact bit shifts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Research §3]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is the partition algorithm for companion `.set` files defined to segment entries into surfaces, left walls, right walls, and clutter? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Research §4]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the exact row-based RLE command byte codes (`0x00`, `0x80`, literal copy, repeated byte) specified for sprite archive decoding? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Research §5]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the Autodesk 776-byte palette format specified with exact header offsets and 256 RGB byte indexing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Research §5]

## 2. Coordinate Geometry & Isometric Projection Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Are the mathematical formulas for forward world-to-screen dimetric isometric projection explicitly defined? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context, Research §6]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the inverse screen-to-world projection formula specified for cursor mouse-picking across vertical elevation planes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Research §6]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are tile dimension ratios (2:1 aspect ratio) and vertical elevation displacement steps quantified? [Clarity, Research §6, Data Model §Camera]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the depth-sorting strategy (ordering by elevation, grid distance $X+Y$, and sub-component priority) explicitly defined to prevent occlusion artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Research §7]

## 3. Viewport UX & Interaction Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Are navigation controls (panning, mouse drag, cursor-centered zooming, view reset) defined with specific input bindings? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 2, Contracts §api-contracts]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are layer elevation filtering controls specified for both single-layer isolation and cumulative maximum elevation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are toggle interactions defined for individual structural categories (floors, left walls, right walls, clutter)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the bottom status bar information model specified with exact coordinates $(X, Y, Z)$ and tile component identifiers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are detailed inspection sidebar fields defined for displaying sprite dimensions, offsets, flags, and tileset associations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the 2D top-down minimap corner overlay specified with camera viewport positioning indicators? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Spec §User Story 2]

## 4. Edge Cases, Error Handling & Fallback Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 - Is fallback placeholder behavior specified when referenced sprite archives (`.obj`) or tilesets (`.set`) cannot be located on disk? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-013, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are error messages and exit codes defined for missing map paths, corrupted headers, and unresolvable asset roots? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Contracts §cli-contract]
- [ ] CHK019 - Does the specification define behavior when map dimensions reach maximum engine boundaries (130x100) or minimum bounds (20x20)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §2]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the behavior for unpopulated or sparse elevation layers defined to avoid rendering performance degradation? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is window resizing behavior specified to prevent aspect ratio distortion or camera disorientation? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]

## 5. Architecture Decoupling & Testability

- [ ] CHK022 - Are the map data model, parsers, and coordinate math specified to be completely independent of Arcade or Pygame display dependencies? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check, Contracts §api-contracts]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the `IRenderer` interface defined with sufficient abstraction to allow Arcade and Pygame backends to be swapped interchangeably? [Clarity, Plan §Architecture, Contracts §api-contracts]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are automated unit testing requirements specified to execute in headless environments without launching an interactive GUI window? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Quickstart §Scenario 1]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is a synthetic test fixture strategy defined to validate parsers without strictly requiring commercial game asset installations? [Completeness, Plan §Testing, Quickstart §Scenario 1]

## 6. Non-Functional Requirements & Performance Measurability

- [ ] CHK026 - Is the viewport rendering performance target quantified with a measurable frame rate ($\ge 60$ FPS) and frame time budget ($\le 16.6$ ms)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is initial map load time quantified with a measurable threshold ($< 2$ seconds for standard maps)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is CLI parameter error termination quantified with a measurable response time threshold ($< 500$ ms)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are memory management requirements defined for decoded sprite caching and palette transforms to prevent unbounded memory growth? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context, Research §5]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially (CHK001–CHK029) for easy reference and review tracking.
